messages:
Priya: getting multiple incoming SEV tickets — customers seeing 502/504 + long timeouts on hosted /v1/generate since ~10:35 PDT. Billing complaints about retry charges. Paging oncall.

DeployBot: CANARY DEPLOY: model-serving v3.2 -> 10% traffic (edge-gateway tag: canary-a). Started at 10:33 PDT.

Minh: confirming, I'm seeing a sharp jump in 5xx at the edge layer around 10:34. Traces point to increased upstream timeouts to model-serving pool nodes (worker-pool-12).

Elaine: metrics: p50 latency up from 120ms -> 1.2s, p95 ~ 6s on west-us region. Error budget tripped for a few routes.

Jason: which flag/variant did the canary flip? any recent kernel or batching changes? customers complaining retries doubled their token billing.

Minh: canary enabled a batching optimization + new kernel selector for sequence-length heuristics. There's also a new "prefetch_kvcache" flag set true in canary. Suspect cache warmup issue + batching causing longer tails.

Priya: a customer (acct: acme-inc) pasted this repro curl — they run retries automatically and got charged heavy. Repro snippet they sent:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"x-large","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":512}'
```

They see 504 after 30s, then their client retries twice.

OpsBot: recent gateway log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T17:34:12Z edge-gw-3 upstream_timeout id=abc123 route=/v1/generate target=worker-pool-12 reason=kvcache-miss
2026-03-17T17:34:13Z edge-gw-3 502_response id=abc124 upstream=worker-pool-12 latency=6002ms
```

Minh: yeah logs match. If prefetch is misbehaving we could be thrashing KV cache and increasing tail latencies, especially for long sequences. Batching optimization might be increasing backend request sizes and pushing some requests over timeout.

Elaine: immediate mitigation: roll the canary back to previous routing variant and disable prefetch flag. Who can flip the routing tag? Need rollback ASAP and then monitor for customer impact.

Minh: I can flip routing. Rollback command (run from deployctl):
```
deployctl routes set-tag --service edge-gateway --tag canary-a --percent 0 --author "minh"
deployctl config unset --service model-serving --key prefetch_kvcache --author "minh"
```

DeployBot: ACK. Scheduling route update...

DeployBot: ROUTE UPDATE: canary-a -> 0% (initiated).

Elaine: monitoring dashboard — error rate spiking started to decline 2m after route change. p95 down to 1s.

Priya: CS: I'm drafting messages to impacted accounts and recommending one-time billing adjustment for automatic retries. Jason, can you own credits?

Jason: on it. will prepare credit proposal and confirm list of impacted orgs.

Minh: post-rollback, I'll run a small canary with prefetch_kvcache=false and batching at earlier settings in a staging shadow to validate. Need to add a KV warmup and circuit-breaker for kvcache misses.

Elaine: open action items: Minh -> follow-up fix + test plan; Jason -> credits + customer comms; Priya -> ticket triage + SLA escalations; Ops -> confirm audit log for the flag change.

Priya: thanks all. Please add any further observations. :thumbsup:

Minh: one more datapoint — replicas behind worker-pool-12 show GC spikes around the same time. Could be combined effect (GC + batching). I'll dig into kernel selection logs.

OpsBot: NOTE: audit entry created for config change by minh at 2026-03-17T17:36:05Z.

Elaine: continuing to monitor for 15m, will close when stable and errors back to baseline.

Priya: closing loop: error rate down to baseline after rollback, customers notified, billing credit workflow started. Will follow up in a postmortem thread with timelines and root cause once Minh confirms fix.
